original_test_intent: Prove that the HMC-owned logical I2C-1 management path, not an unrelated BMC adapter, is physically connected to the first HPM in the approved 1P configuration and can safely identify every required first-HPM device through the exact HMC controller and mux route.
original_method: Establish whether HMC is the bus controller or exposes an approved proxy through BMC/OOB, and bind logical HMC I2C-1 to controller, access endpoint, adapter, mux/channel and first-HPM connector; confirm 1P/HPM0 population; define first-HPM 7-bit addresses and read-safe identity registers/values; have an operator inspect/photograph the physical path; preserve HMC/BMC/bus logs; execute only approved read-only identity operations from the authoritative HMC path; reject evidence from an unmapped BMC bus and stop on first fault without write/reset/retry.
manual_activity: An operator confirms the 1P/first-HPM population, inspects the HMC-to-first-HPM connector/cable and supplies path-bound photos; the owner identifies the authoritative HMC access endpoint.
required_inputs: HMC/BMC ownership diagram and exact native HMC or approved BMC-proxy access path for logical HMC I2C-1
HMC controller/adapter/mux/channel/first-HPM connector map and approved 1P population
Expected first-HPM device 7-bit addresses, read-safe identity registers/masks/values and prohibited transactions
Physical inspection procedure, HMC/BMC bus-error acceptance, aborts and recovery
safety_requirements: Use only the authoritative HMC management path or explicitly mapped proxy; do not assume a BMC adapter is equivalent
Never quick-write, scan unknown devices, write EEPROM/control registers or access an unapproved mux channel
Preserve HMC/BMC and bus logs and keep the management plane stable
Stop on ownership ambiguity, wrong-path response, missing/unexpected device, timeout, stuck bus, arbitration storm or HMC/BMC instability
agent_execution_scope: Validate HMC ownership/proxy, first-HPM population/topology, device oracle and transaction allowlist
After physical confirmation, collect read-only identity and bus-health evidence through the authoritative HMC path
Distinguish HMC I2C-1 evidence from any similarly numbered BMC bus
Do not guess access surface, probe unknown addresses, perform writes, reset management controllers or issue the DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve HMC versus BMC ownership/proxy and exact I2C-1 controller/mux/first-HPM path
Approve 1P state, expected devices/registers/values, safe commands, physical procedure, error limits and recovery
Review physical and HMC-path evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: i2cdetect/i2cget may be usable only on an approved HMC endpoint or mapped proxy; its proposed BMC console and literal `I2C-1` cannot demonstrate the source-required HMC path.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the owner-approved HMC-native or explicitly mapped proxy read-only method on the exact first-HPM channel and query only allowlisted identity registers, retaining access-path and response evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: HMC I2C-1 to first-HPM/1P scope, AI_VR_I2C_HMCbus1 bundle, and 10/10-minute allocation remain; the access endpoint and device map are not inferred.

modernized_recommendation.status: MEDIUM HMC-OWNERSHIP-BOUND FIRST-HPM PHYSICAL AND I2C FUNCTIONAL CHECK
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Prove the management-controller ownership and access route first, then combine operator-confirmed first-HPM connectivity with safe device-identity reads on the exact HMC controller/mux path.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds HMC/BMC path disambiguation, 1P population proof, exact topology, safe identity oracle, photos and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A similarly numbered BMC bus can return plausible devices while leaving the actual HMC-first-HPM path untested; a raw ACK or photo alone is insufficient.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Management-controller bus access may be proxied or locked by firmware; generic scans can disturb live devices and wrong-path evidence can create a false pass.

project_override_considerations: A BMC command can substitute only when the platform specification proves it proxies the exact HMC I2C-1 controller/channel and returns target-bound identities. Independent BMC or host-I2C enumeration is not equivalent.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, authorization and HMC/BMC ownership/proxy diagram
Proof of 1P first-HPM population plus operator connection photos
HMC controller/access endpoint/adapter/mux/channel/connector map and expected device/register/value allowlist
Exact approved commands and complete target-bound identity-response comparison
Pre/post HMC/BMC/I2C timeout/NACK/arbitration/stuck-bus evidence and stable management state

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure, Criteria and bundle consistently name HMC I2C-1 and first-HPM/1P. The BMC-console suggestion exists only in the AI review and is explicitly not adopted without a platform mapping.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The HMC-first-HPM objective is clear. Controller ownership, access path, device map and operator evidence are supplyable prerequisites.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2161 Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00048-V002: approve HMC versus BMC ownership and the authoritative HMC-native or BMC-proxy access path for logical HMC I2C-1; controller/adapter/mux/channel/first-HPM connector map and 1P population; expected 7-bit devices and stable read-safe identity registers/values; prohibited transactions, physical photo procedure, error limits, aborts, and recovery.

review_improvement: Prevents a BMC console with the same logical bus number from falsely satisfying an explicitly HMC-owned path and adds safe, identity-bearing first-HPM proof.
independent_technical_reasoning: Controller ownership is part of coverage: I2C-1 on HMC and I2C-1 on BMC can be physically different buses. The source explicitly names HMC, so a BMC command is acceptable only through a documented proxy to that same path. Address ACKs behind muxes are ambiguous; stable identity reads and physical population evidence must bind the response to the first HPM. This preserves both functional and physical intent without unsafe generic probing.
